(Search snippet content — full article timed out on direct fetch; ITV News's own reporting language)

Labour has said it will end its power-sharing agreements with the Green Party on local councils if they do not reject the "Zionism is Racism" policy adopted earlier this month. The ultimatum will impact 18 councils across England and one in Wales.
All Labour council groups who are currently in coalition with the Greens at council level have been asked to write to the party and seek "reassurances" they condemn the motion, which was passed at Green Party conference and has been widely condemned as antisemitic.
If the Greens do not respond in seven days, then Labour has said it will end its power-sharing arrangements.
